title: Computed properties with get and set
summary: Expose Fahrenheit as a computed view of stored Celsius, with a setter that converts back.
triggers: a property is derived from another stored representation
prompts: Store temperature once while allowing reads and writes in two units.
invariant: Celsius is the single stored source of truth.
mantra: Compute on read; convert on write.
pitfalls: Assigning fahrenheit inside its own setter would recurse.
Use a tolerance when testing general floating-point conversions.
